mapper.sql: pay10_month_id AS month_id, pay10_company_id AS company_id, pay10_pay_cd AS pay_cd, pay10_date AS date, pay10_person_id AS person_id, COALESCE(pay10_work_day, 0) AS work_day, COALESCE(pay10_total_work_time, 0) AS total_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_extend_work_time, 0) AS extend_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_night_work_time, 0) AS night_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_holiday_work_time, 0) AS holiday_work_time, pay10_note AS note, pay10_std_month AS std_month, emp01_emp_no AS person_no, f_emp_kor_nm(pay10_person_id) AS person_nm, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS pos_nm, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '1') AS pay_sum, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '2') AS tax_ddc_sum, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '1') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay11_item_amt), 0) FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_id = pay10_month_id AND pay11_item_type = '2') AS deduction_sum
mapper.select: SELECT pay10_month_id AS month_id, pay10_company_id AS company_id, pay10_pay_cd AS pay_cd, pay10_date AS date, pay10_person_id AS person_id, COALESCE(pay10_work_day, 0) AS work_day, COALESCE(pay10_total_work_time, 0) AS total_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_extend_work_time, 0) AS extend_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_night_work_time, 0) AS night_work_time, COALESCE(pay10_holiday_work_time, 0) AS holiday_work_time, pay10_note AS note, pay10_std_month AS std_month, NULL::varchar AS person_no, NULL::varchar AS person_nm, NULL::varchar AS pos_nm, NULL::numeric AS pay_sum, NULL::numeric AS tax_ddc_sum, NULL::numeric AS deduction_sum FROM pay10_month WHERE pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_month_id IN #{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp01_person_id = #{personId}

SELECT COALESCE(pay01_basic_pay, 0) AS basic_pay, COALESCE(pay01_over_pay, 0) AS over_pay, COALESCE(pay01_etc01_pay, 0) AS etc01_pay, COALESCE(pay01_etc02_pay, 0) AS etc02_pay, COALESCE(pay01_meal_pay, 0) AS meal_pay, COALESCE(pay01_car_mt, 0) AS car_mt, COALESCE(pay01_childcare_allowance, 0) AS childcare_allowance FROM pay01_annual WHERE pay01_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay01_person_id = #{personId} AND pay01_start_date IN ( SELECT MAX(a.pay01_start_date) FROM pay01_annual a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON a.pay01_appr_id = b.apr01_appr_id WHERE a.pay01_person_id = #{personId} AND b.apr01_status_cd = '30' AND a.pay01_start_date <= #{payDate} ) ORDER BY pay01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay10_month (pay10_month_id, pay10_company_id, pay10_pay_cd, pay10_date, pay10_person_id, pay10_work_day, pay10_total_work_time, pay10_extend_work_time, pay10_night_work_time, pay10_holiday_work_time, pay10_std_month) VALUES (#{monthId}, #{companyId}, #{payCode}, #{payDate}, #{personId}, #{workDay}, #{totalWorkTime}, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{stdMonth})
INSERT INTO pay11_month_item (pay11_month_item_id, pay11_month_id, pay11_item_type, pay11_item_cd, pay11_item_amt) VALUES (#{monthItemId}, #{monthId}, #{itemType}, #{itemCode}, #{itemAmt})
